requirements.text: This is a full-time, office-based role in San Francisco. The team values close collaboration, fast iteration, high ownership, and a strong commitment to delivering results.
Strong software engineering fundamentals and the ability to build clean, reliable, production-quality systems.
A strong general technical background, with an interest in machine learning, AI, or related disciplines.
The ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and technical concepts quickly.
A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with the initiative to take projects from concept through implementation.
High levels of ownership, adaptability, and intellectual curiosity.

The environment is intense and best suited to people who enjoy working hard, tackling difficult problems, and learning rapidly alongside ambitious engineers and researchers. Candidates should be comfortable with a demanding startup environment and a high level of commitment to the work.
Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:

Candidates with a bachelor's or master's degree, a PhD, or equivalent practical experience are all welcome to apply. Exceptional early-career engineers will be considered alongside more experienced candidates.
